instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, full shot. In a cozy bedroom with floral wallpaper and a woven rug, a family playfully exercises. The bearded man in a white t-shirt and striped pajama pants (R1) planks on the rug, facing right. Sitting on his back is the woman in a white button-down shirt and white pajama pants (R3), who smiles as she holds up the blonde toddler in striped pajamas (R2). The toddler stands on the planking man's lower back, supported by the woman's hands. Soft, natural light fills the room, highlighting the warm, neutral tones of the bedroom decor.
